subject: Session-expiry messages are never shown: clearTokensAndRedirect writes them to the memory-only auth store and then reloads the page
activeForm: Making session-expiry messages survive the redirect

origin.evidence: sed -n '/function clearTokensAndRedirect/,/^}/p' frontend/src/lib/api/errors.ts; grep -n 'Memory-only store' frontend/src/stores/auth-store.ts

work_items: Card #26: show the AUTH_013/014/018 message after the forced redirect

description: Found by card #17 on 2026-10-14 while routing hard navigations through hardNavigate(). clearTokensAndRedirect in frontend/src/lib/api/errors.ts resets the auth store, calls setError(message), then navigates with a full page load. The auth store is memory-only by design since feature 1165 (frontend/src/stores/auth-store.ts:101), so the reload discards the error before anything renders it. The three handlers that use it (AUTH_013, AUTH_014, AUTH_018 in AUTH_ERROR_HANDLERS) therefore drop the user on / with no explanation; AUTH_018 is 'Session expired. Please sign in again.' Read from the code, not reproduced in a browser. Likely fix: carry the message across the reload in sessionStorage (or a query parameter) and show it once on load, keeping tokens out of storage.
